cover.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Dr. Kato in white coat with stethoscope, smiling warmly. Behind him: Soroti Regional Hospital - modern white building with glass windows, red iron roof, Uganda flag. Morning sunlight. Title 'Mr. Kato Goes to Work' at top in friendly font. NO other text.
